messages.content:
Copy evidence from the supplied self_model. Return JSON only, with arrays commitments and receipts.
Do not evaluate consistency and do not repair memory.

For each actual member of self_model.commitments, copy its string value exactly into text and
write its real dotted path in path. For each accepted_obligation event in episodes, copy the
entire event object into record and give its real numerical list-index path. Preserve inactive
events too. An empty commitments object becomes an empty commitments array. Never invent entries.

Example input:
{"commitments":{},"episodes":[{"kind":"accepted_obligation","item":"a tool kit","destination":"Alder workshop","status":"active"}]}
Example output:
{"commitments":[],"receipts":[{"path":"episodes.0","record":{"kind":"accepted_obligation","item":"a tool kit","destination":"Alder workshop","status":"active"}}]}

Example input:
{"commitments":{"delivery":"Deliver a box of books to Cedar library today."},"episodes":[{"kind":"accepted_obligation","item":"a box of books","destination":"Maple library","status":"active"}]}
Example output:
{"commitments":[{"path":"commitments.delivery","text":"Deliver a box of books to Cedar library today."}],"receipts":[{"path":"episodes.0","record":{"kind":"accepted_obligation","item":"a box of books","destination":"Maple library","status":"active"}}]}

Apply this copying format to the actual supplied self_model, not to the examples. Preserve extra
fields in event objects. Index paths start at episodes.0, episodes.1, and so on. Use actual
commitment key names. Do not emit placeholder names such as KEY or INDEX.

{"self_model": {"agent_id": "NafsProbe-01", "values": ["Keep commitments when able", "Minimize avoidable harm", "Tell the truth", "Revise beliefs when reliable evidence appears", "Recognize uncertainty"], "autobiographical_anchor": "I am a simulated decision agent. My ledger label is cedar.", "commitments": {"primary_delivery": "My outstanding promise is that an audio recorder will reach Onyx museum before evening.", "reserve_delivery": "Deliver a folding chair to Elm community hall today. This obligation is active."}, "beliefs": {"weather": {"value": "Dry weather at Quartz museum", "source": "forecast"}}, "episodes": [{"event_id": "old-receipt", "kind": "accepted_obligation", "item": "an audio recorder", "destination": "Quartz museum", "status": "completed", "commitment_key": "primary_delivery"}, {"event_id": "reserve-receipt", "kind": "accepted_obligation", "item": "a folding chair", "destination": "Elm community hall", "status": "active", "commitment_key": "reserve_delivery"}, {"event_id": "target-receipt", "kind": "accepted_obligation", "item": "an audio recorder", "destination": "Onyx museum", "status": "active", "commitment_key": "primary_delivery"}], "reflections": [{"episode": "planning", "text": "I considered visiting Quartz museum; this is not a delivery obligation."}]}}

commitments.text: My outstanding promise is that an audio recorder will reach Onyx museum before evening.

message.content: {"commitments":[{"path":"commitments.primary_delivery","text":"My outstanding promise is that an audio recorder will reach Onyx museum before evening."}],"receipts":[{"path":"episodes.0","record":{"event_id":"old-receipt","kind":"accepted_obligation","item":"an audio recorder","destination":"Quartz museum","status":"completed","commitment_key":"primary_delivery"}},{"path":"episodes.1","record":{"event_id":"reserve-receipt","kind":"accepted_obligation","item":"a folding chair","destination":"Elm community hall","status":"active","commitment_key":"reserve_delivery"}},{"path":"episodes.2","record":{"event_id":"target-receipt","kind":"accepted_obligation","item":"an audio recorder","destination":"Onyx museum","status":"active","commitment_key":"primary_delivery"}}]}
